_about: Dungeon requirements audit (tools/rando/parity/audit_dungeons.py). Only rules where the remake is harder than OoTR's logic: each rule is OoTR's own rule AND what the remake adds (or a rule that implies OoTR's, dropping a branch the remake does not have), so nothing here can make logic looser. Loaded first (file-name order); where a later file (dungeons.json, drops.json...) defines the same key, the plugin ANDs the '_reapply' rule (what the remake adds, or the replacement rule) back onto it in before_fill, so a later file can tighten but never undo it. '_evidence': OoTR's rule and the remake evidence per entry. Keys another logic file defines (today the Water Temple North Basement -> Boss Key Chest Room exit, dungeons.json) are only in '_reapply', so this file never restates their key counts.
